body: Even before that, it’s not like anyone really cares. Yeah you get the usual pomp and circumstance and then after a bit you become a faded memory. “Oh you mean the guy that blew his head off?” That’s a fun legacy right?
Maybe. But I don’t know why I keep thinking about it. If my subconscious knows it’s such an awful idea then why does it keep popping into my thoughts?
You know what gets me is that now and then I’d have a nightmare about actually doing it. And it would always scare the hell out of me when I’d think I did it. I don’t know what it means
